{"version":"2b1","blocks":[{"type":"text","text":"Compare Native Hybrid, Tauri, and Electron across three criteria: native experience, lightweight runtime, and delivery efficiency. Adjust weights to see how rankings change. If all weights are zero, no ranking is shown."},{"type":"ui","source":"$w1 = 40
$w2 = 25
$w3 = 35
sum = $w1 + $w2 + $w3
nw1 = sum == 0 ? 0 : $w1 / sum
nw2 = sum == 0 ? 0 : $w2 / sum
nw3 = sum == 0 ? 0 : $w3 / sum
score_native = 9 * nw1 + 8 * nw2 + 7 * nw3
score_tauri = 7 * nw1 + 8 * nw2 + 8 * nw3
score_electron = 6 * nw1 + 4 * nw2 + 10 * nw3
rows = [
  {label:"Native Hybrid",score:score_native},
  {label:"Tauri",score:score_tauri},
  {label:"Electron",score:score_electron}
]
sorted = sum == 0 ? rows : @Sort(rows,"score","desc")
root = Stack([
  Text("Set weights for each criterion (0-100). Scores are normalized. Weighted scores determine ranking."),
  Control("Native Experience",0,100,[],$w1),
  Control("Lightweight Runtime",0,100,[],$w2),
  Control("Delivery Efficiency",0,100,[],$w3),
  Table(sorted)
])","state":[{"name":"$w1","value":40},{"name":"$w2","value":25},{"name":"$w3","value":35}]}]}
